Product.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Offering; iri=euo:Product; meta=false; state=-] Product / Produkt — Something Lumora sells as a whole: Lumora Desk for Treuhand firms or the Lumora API for software partners.

PlatformTier.description: [level=lumora; parent=euo:Product; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Platform tier / Plattform-Stufe — One of the three cumulative levels of the Platform that a customer buys: Start, Team or Scale. Each includes the one before it.

ApiServiceGroup.description: [level=lumora; parent=euo:Product; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] API service group / API-Dienstgruppe — A grouping of the Lumora API as software vendors and partners see it (Ingest, Search).

Capability.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:RealizableEntity; iri=euo:Capability; meta=false; state=status] Capability / Fähigkeit — One thing a customer can do with Lumora, in plain words. It is the meeting point between what management sells and what engineering builds.

BoundedContext.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Software; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Software area (L1) / Software-Bereich (L1) — One of the large areas the Lumora software is divided into; each has its own responsibility and vocabulary and contains several components (L2).

System.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Software; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] System / System — The Lumora software as a whole; its software areas are part of it, and its reference documentation starts here.

Interface.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Interface / Schnittstelle — An HTTP route a software component serves, with its methods and the page that documents it; read from the code.

Interaction.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Process; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Interaction / Komponentenaufruf — One software component calling another: which methods, over which protocol, under which contract.

Component.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:MaterialObject; iri=eng:Component; meta=false; state=alloy_status] Software component (L2/L3) / Software-Komponente (L2/L3) — A part of the Lumora software with a clear responsibility, its own documentation and tests, inside one software area.

ComponentContract.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Requirement; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Component contract / Komponentenvertrag — A promise a component makes: what must be true before it runs (precondition), what is true afterwards (postcondition), or what it is responsible for.

Invariant.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Requirement; iri=-; meta=false; state=catalog_status] Golden invariant / Goldene Invariante — A rule the whole system must keep at all times, written down with an id, verified by tests and formal checks.

FeaturePlan.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:DirectiveContent; iri=euo:Plan; meta=false; state=status] Feature plan / Feature-Plan — The written plan for a piece of work: what problem it solves, which components it changes, which contracts and invariants apply, and its status from draft to released.

Phase.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Plan; iri=-; meta=true; state=-] Phase / Phase — A dated stretch of a plan that ends at a gate.

Gate.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Milestone; iri=euo:Milestone; meta=true; state=status] Gate / Gate (Prüfpunkt) — A checkpoint at the end of a phase with a pass criterion the brain itself can check; the next phase starts only when it passes.

Milestone.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Occurrent; iri=euo:Milestone; meta=false; state=-] Milestone / Meilenstein — A dated point in a plan, such as a launch or a contract, by which something must be done.

Goal.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:DirectiveContent; iri=euo:Objective; meta=false; state=status] Goal / Ziel — What must change by the end of a month or a quarter, owned by a role, measured by key results.

KeyResult.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Objective; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Key result / Schlüsselergebnis — A measurable target on one metric that shows whether a goal was reached: baseline, target and actual value.

Metric.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Metric / Kennzahl — A named, computable measure with a unit and a direction (up or down is better).

MetricSample.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Observation; iri=euo:Observation; meta=false; state=-] Metric sample / Messwert — One measured value of a metric at a point in time, computed by a script, never typed by hand.

Decision.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=euo:Decision; meta=false; state=status] Decision / Entscheidung — A recorded choice with its date, who made it, what it affects and what it replaces, moving from proposed to decided.

Risk.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=euo:Risk; meta=false; state=status] Risk / Risiko — Something that could go wrong, with an owner, a review date and either a mitigation or an explicit acceptance.

Hypothesis.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=euo:Assumption; meta=false; state=status] Hypothesis / Hypothese — A belief about customers or the product that has not been proven yet, with a status from asserted to validated or refuted.

Experiment.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:PlannedProcess; iri=-; meta=false; state=status] Experiment / Experiment — A registered test of a hypothesis with keep and kill thresholds set before it starts and an end date.

Result.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Observation; iri=euo:Observation; meta=false; state=verdict] Result / Ergebnis — The measured outcome of an experiment or campaign, with the verdict the evaluation proposes.

PreMortem.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Meeting; iri=euo:Meeting; meta=false; state=-] Pre-mortem / Pre-Mortem — A session before a big plan or decision in which the team assumes it already failed and writes down why; it produces risks and tripwires.

Tripwire.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:DirectiveContent; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Tripwire / Auslöseschwelle — A threshold on a metric that forces a decision when it fires.

Process.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:DirectiveContent; iri=euo:ProcessDefinition; meta=true; state=-] Process (definition) / Prozess (Definition) — How a kind of work moves: its steps and the allowed transitions, with an owner.

ProcessStep.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:ProcessDefinition; iri=-; meta=true; state=-] Process step / Prozessschritt — One named state of a process.

ProcessInstance.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Occurrent; iri=euo:Process; meta=false; state=-] Process instance / Prozessinstanz — One running case of a process, such as one feature moving through the feature lifecycle.

Event.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Occurrent; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Event / Ereignis — Something that happened in the business at a time, done by a person, touching one or more things in the brain: a decision review held, a step entered, a campaign ended.

RunEvent.description: [level=lumora; parent=euo:Occurrent; iri=-; meta=true; state=-] Run event / Laufereignis — A bookkeeping record of one loader, CI or agent run: when it ran, who ran it and which plans, decisions, risks and components it changed. Instance views hide run events as a whole.

Function.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Organization; iri=euo:OrganizationalUnit; meta=false; state=-] Function / Unternehmensfunktion — A part of the company such as research, engineering, sales or finance.

Role.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Role; iri=euo:OrganizationalRole; meta=false; state=-] Role / Rolle — A hat a person wears, such as ontology steward or engine owner; roles own things, people hold roles.

Person.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Agent; iri=euo:Person; meta=false; state=-] Person / Person — A named person at Lumora (no private data beyond the name).

Agent.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Agent; iri=euo:AutomatedAgent; meta=false; state=-] Agent / KI-Agent — An automated actor such as a Claude Code session or a scheduled job that reads and proposes in the brain.

Market.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:GeographicRegion; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Market / Markt — A region and offering Lumora sells into.

Segment.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Topic; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Customer segment (ICP) / Kundensegment (ICP) — A kind of customer Lumora targets, the ideal customer profile.

Persona.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Role; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Persona / Persona — An archetype of a person in the buying centre of a customer, with pains, goals and a role in the deal.

EvidenceRecord.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Observation; iri=euo:Observation; meta=false; state=-] Evidence record / Evidenzeintrag — A piece of evidence for or against a hypothesis: an interview, a statistic, a source.

Channel.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Service; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Channel / Vertriebskanal — How a segment is reached: direct, resellers, software vendors, events, content.

Campaign.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:PlannedProcess; iri=-; meta=false; state=status] Campaign / Kampagne — A marketing effort aimed at a segment and its personas, run as a registered experiment: it tests a persona hypothesis with a metric, a minimum sample and keep and kill thresholds set before it starts.

MarketingAsset.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Document; iri=euo:Document; meta=false; state=-] Marketing asset / Marketing-Material — A one-pager, deck, demo or case study written for a persona.

Lead.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Party; iri=-; meta=false; state=stage] Lead / Lead — A company that showed interest in a campaign, stored as the account plus the buying-centre role mapped to a persona, never as a name or contact detail (privacy rule).

Account.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Party; iri=euo:Organization; meta=false; state=-] Account / Kunde (Organisation) — A prospect or customer organisation.

Opportunity.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Transaction; iri=-; meta=false; state=stage] Opportunity / Verkaufschance — A deal in the sales pipeline with its stage and its MEDDPICC qualification.

Quote.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Document; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Quote / Angebot — A priced offer: articles, seats, API buckets.

Contract.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Agreement; iri=euo:Contract; meta=false; state=-] Contract / Vertrag — A signed agreement with a customer or partner.

Customer.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:PartyRole; iri=euo:CustomerRole; meta=false; state=onboarding_state] Customer / Kunde (Beziehung) — An account that signed, from onboarding through renewal, expansion or churn.

Record.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=euo:Document; meta=false; state=stale] Record / Dokument (Beschreibung) — A human-written description of how things are: a README, a spec, a glossary page, a runbook. It must point at the ground truth it describes and is flagged stale when that changes.

Repository.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:InformationCarrier; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Repository / Code-Repository — A git repository holding code or documents.

SourceFile.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=eng:CodeArtifact; meta=false; state=-] Source file / Quelldatei — One code or model file in a repository, with a content hash so changes are noticed.

Symbol.description: [level=pack; parent=eng:CodeArtifact; iri=eng:CodeArtifact; meta=false; state=-] Symbol / Code-Symbol — A class, function or method inside a source file.

Commit.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Change; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Commit / Commit — One recorded change to a repository, linked to the plan it implements and the components it touched.

TestRun.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Process; iri=eng:TestExecution; meta=false; state=outcome] Test run / Testlauf — The result of running one test module on a date: passed or failed, how many tests.

AlloyCheck.description: [level=lumora; parent=eng:TestExecution; iri=-; meta=false; state=outcome] Alloy check / Alloy-Prüfung — One formal check of a system model (Alloy) recorded in the lockfile; it verifies a component or an invariant.

GlossaryTerm.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Designation; iri=euo:Designation; meta=true; state=-] Glossary term / Glossarbegriff — One entry of this glossary inside the brain: a type, attribute, relation or value with its plain-language description.

Release.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:PlannedProcess; iri=-; meta=false; state=status] Release / Release (Version) — A versioned release of the software moving from candidate through verified and deployed to announced; recorded by the engine owner in releases.yaml because no git tag or deploy flow marks releases today.

Spine.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=-; meta=true; state=-] Spine / Strukturachse — An ordered list of levels — a type at each level and the relation that links it to the level above — along which the company's things hang: product, organisation, process, market. The Platform draws trees and matrices from it.

SpineLevel.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=-; meta=true; state=-] Spine level / Ebene einer Strukturachse — One level of a spine: the node types allowed there and the relation to the parent level.

Company.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:Party; iri=euo:Organization; meta=false; state=-] Company / Unternehmen — The company itself, root of the organisation spine.

ValueStream.description: [level=euo; parent=euo:PlannedProcess; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Value stream / Wertstrom — A group of processes that together deliver one kind of value, root of the process spine.

Deployment.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Process; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Deployment / Deployment — A release of the software to an environment on a date.

Service.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Software; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Service / Dienst (laufend) — A piece of the software that is deployed and keeps running, such as an API server or the embedding service; it executes one or more components in one or more environments.

Job.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Software; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Scheduled job / Geplanter Job — A piece of the software that is started on a schedule, does its work and stops, such as a nightly aggregation.

Environment.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Location; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Environment / Umgebung — A place where the software runs: one cluster or host of one stage, local, dev or prod.

DataStore.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Software; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Data store / Datenspeicher — A database, cache, vector index or file store the software keeps data in; it holds tables or collections.

DataSet.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Dataset; iri=euo:Dataset; meta=false; state=-] Data set / Datenbestand (Tabelle) — One table, collection, bucket or keyspace inside a data store, with the components that read and write it.

Setting.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:InformationContentEntity; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Setting / Einstellung — One configuration key the software reads, with its default: a plain setting, a feature flag that switches something on or off, or a secret whose value is never recorded.

Workflow.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:ProcessDefinition; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] CI workflow / CI-Workflow — An automated pipeline that tests, checks, builds or deploys the software when something happens, such as a push or a schedule; made of jobs.

WorkflowJob.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:ProcessDefinition; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] CI job / CI-Job — One job of a CI workflow, such as running the tests or building the images; it may wait for other jobs.

Library.description: [level=pack; parent=euo:Software; iri=-; meta=false; state=-] Library / Fremdbibliothek — A third-party package the software uses, with its version and licence.

nodes.name: Feature lifecycle
nodes.description: How a feature goes from idea to release at Lumora: a plan file is the brief; it names the components it changes, the capability and goal it serves, the contracts and invariants it must keep; an Alloy model and (above the size threshold) a pre-mortem precede approval; commits implement it; tests and checks verify it; a release ships it.
